entries.description: An intentional community in Frankfort, Maine, spanning 100 acres with housing, camping space, woods, and uncultivated farmland. Currently one resident living in Boston, building a permanent structure for May-October. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, older lesbians, artists, working class dykes, and 12-step program dykes. No alcohol or drugs allowed. Focuses on older women, working-class women, lesbian separatism, recovery/substance-free, and archives/cultural work (lesbian burial ground).
entries.raw_text: DUTCH MOUNTAIN c/o Eileen Kennedy, 91 Rossmore Rd #3, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130 (617)522-2472 (Frankfort, ME, 12 mi from Belfast; mid-coast). I am a 39-year-old working class Lesbian separatist, artist and environmental educator with a long-time dream of an intergenerational Lesbian community (from infancy to very elderly), including a Lesbian burial ground. I'm currently living in Boston, but building May, Sept & Oct 86 - finally! Write c/o General Delivery, Frankfort, ME 04438 while I'm building. I will need a dyke(s) to cabinsint or rent real cheap through winter and maybe longer. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children, older lesbians, artists, working class dykes, 12-step program dykes. No alcohol or drugs of any kind. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 100 acres, housing/permanent structure this year, camping space, woods, uncultivated farmland.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'dream of an intergenerational Lesbian community'. Accepted groups: 'girl children' is explicitly welcomed. Lesbians are assumed by default. Focuses: 'older lesbians' (Older women), 'working class dykes' (Working-class women), 'Lesbian separatist' (Lesbian separatism), '12-step program dykes' (Recovery/substance-free), 'artists' (Archives/cultural work). Land location is Frankfort, ME from text. Acreage is 100.

entries.land_location_as_stated: off Rte 27 at Kingston & Pembroke Town Line on Silver Lake
entries.description: An intentional community on 100 acres in Bryantville, Massachusetts, offering scenic grounds, work experience, secluded outdoor space, ponds, organic gardens, small livestock, and bees. Welcomes new members, girl and boy children, non-lesbian women, males (maybe), dogs on leashes, and horses. Focuses on farming/self-sufficiency, workshops/education, and environmentalism/eco-friendly.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM PO Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-8826 (off Rte 27 at Kingston & Pembroke Town Line on Silver Lake). We offer scenic grounds and meaningful work experience with easy access to Boston and Cape Cod - secluded outdoor space available to groups and individuals for workshops, retreats, etc. Accomodations are rough (outhouse, barn kitchen) - ponds for swimming, fishing, canoe - organic gardens, small livestock, bees. Usual donation for camping $6 a night. We welcome: new members, girl & boy children, non-lesbian women, males (maybe), dogs on leashes, horses. BYO food. We have/are: two with a girl child, 100 acres, 1 house, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as they are 'women living and working on the land' welcoming new members. Accepted groups: 'girl & boy children' (Girl children, Boy children), 'non-lesbian women' (Non-lesbian women), 'males (maybe)' (Non-gay men). Focuses: 'workshops, retreats, etc.' (Workshops/education), 'organic gardens, small livestock, bees' (Farming/self-sufficiency), 'organic gardens' (Environmentalism/eco-friendly). Acreage is 100.
